hook: iOS 27 fixes the weak Wi-Fi trap

beats.say: iOS 27 adds Connectivity Assist, which notices when Wi-Fi is slow or unusable and uses cellular data to keep your iPhone connected.
Think of leaving the house while your phone clings to weak home Wi-Fi. You'll find the toggle in Settings, under Wi-Fi.
You can turn it off for specific networks, it isn't used while roaming or in Low Data Mode, and it may use more cellular data.
